# Vendor Datasheets

These files are local reference copies of public QST Corporation datasheets used
to review the v0.1.2 driver behavior. Copyright and all other rights remain with
QST Corporation. Consult the source URLs for the current vendor publication.

| File | Document | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `QMI8658A-Datasheet-Rev-D.pdf` | QMI8658A Datasheet, Rev D, document 13-52-25 | [QST source](https://www.qstcorp.com/upload/pdf/202512/13-52-25%20QMI8658A%20Datasheet%20Rev%20D.pdf) |
| `QMI8658C-Datasheet-Rev-A.pdf` | QMI8658C Datasheet, Rev A, document 13-52-27 | [QST source](https://www.qstcorp.com/upload/pdf/202210/13-52-27%20QMI8658C%20Datasheet%20Rev%20A%20%281%29.pdf) |

No official QMI8658B datasheet was located during this review. The crate must
not advertise or implement QMI8658B-specific behavior until that evidence is
available and reviewed.
